response.description: An identifier for the set of taxon information (data associated with the Taxon class). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
response.label: Taxon ID

response.description: A planned process by which an organismal entity is associated with a taxon or taxa.
response.label: taxonomic identification process

response.description: A data item that is the output of a taxonomic identification process and associates some organismal entity with a taxon or taxa.
response.label: identification assertion

response.description: A relation used to link an identification association to an organismal entity. Should be used together with the to taxon relation.
response.label: of organism

response.description: This is more typically used to report multiple sightings, where the motivation is to record presence and abundance, rather than for individual anecdotal occurrences that are noteworthy.
response.label: opportunistic search taxonomic inventory process

response.description: An identifier for the taxonomic concept to which the record refers - not for the nomenclatural details of a taxon.
response.label: Taxon Concept ID

response.description: A string representing the taxonomic identification as it appeared in the original record.
response.label: Verbatim Identification

response.description: A categorical indicator of the extent to which the taxonomic identification has been verified to be correct.
response.label: Identification Verification Status

response.description: A taxonomic determination (e.g., the assignment to a taxon).
response.label: Identification

response.description: A taxonomic determination (e.g., the assignment to a taxon).
response.label: Identification

response.description: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of an Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined. This term should not contain identification qualifications, which should instead be supplied in the IdentificationQualifier term.
response.label: Scientific Name

response.description: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.
response.label: Scientific Name ID

response.description: An identifier for the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied. See nameAccordingTo.
response.label: Name According To ID

response.description: The date on which the subject was determined as representing the Taxon.
response.label: Date Identified

response.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who assigned the Taxon to the subject.
response.label: Identified By

response.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of the globally unique identifier for the person, people, groups, or organizations responsible for assigning the Taxon to the subject.
response.label: Identified By ID

response.description: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) taxon.
response.label: Accepted Name Usage ID

response.description: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the direct, most proximate higher-rank parent taxon (in a classification) of the most specific element of the scientificName.
response.label: Parent Name Usage ID

response.description: The reference to the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied - traditionally signified by the Latin "sensu" or "sec." (from secundum, meaning "according to"). For taxa that result from identifications, a reference to the keys, monographs, experts and other sources should be given.
response.label: Name According To
